basic_info.description: Spacious Top Floor Condominium located on one of the Marina's most sought-after blocks just steps from Chestnut Street. This full floor flat receives wonderful natural light and comes with exclusive roof rights. Two large bedrooms and bright sunroom can be used as a third bedroom or home office. The living room spans the width of the property and a generous size dining room create a wonderful space for entertaining. The kitchen is also spacious and receives so much natural light, tastefully updated to include European style cabinetry, quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. This rare offering combines timeless architectural character, modern amenities, and an unbeatable Marina location.  Period details include intricate moldings, leaded glass windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, built-in bookcases, and fireplace. Additional features include in-unit laundry, One-car parking and two deeded storage spaces. HOA Dues of $465 per month + annual payment for Earthquake Insurance Policy.
